judgment.rationale: The issue is a closely related manifestation of the same Peek scaling/window-sizing defect tracked by #50445 and potentially #50244. The shared implementation path makes a separate fix queue entry duplicative, while the author still needs to confirm the exact repro matrix.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate implementation under #50445 and retain the 4K/175% evidence when validating the shared Peek sizing and centering fix.

evidence.fact: The report shows image-dependent horizontal offset and a smaller vertical offset at 4K/175% scaling.
The automated triage identified #50244 and #50445 as possible duplicates.
Peek computes scaled preview size, clamps to monitor bounds, accounts for title-bar height, and calls CenterOnMonitor in MainWindow.FilePreviewer_PreviewSizeChanged.

fix_assessment.rationale: No separate fix should be designed while the same scaling and client-area sizing path is being handled as part of #50445.

issue_context.summary: Peek images are reported off-center, especially horizontally, on a 4K display at 175% scaling, with position varying by image dimensions.
known_information: The issue is open, assigned to daverayment, and labeled Needs-Author-Feedback, Needs-Triage, and Product-Peek.
No bug report was attached; screenshots and a video were supplied.
The current Peek code has a shared size-change and centering path with #50445.
inferences: The centering offset may be a downstream effect of the same scaled client-area dimensions that produce the seams in #50445.

comment.body: This report appears to be a separate symptom of the Peek sizing/scaling path already tracked in #50445: both reports vary with image dimensions and display scaling, and the implementation converges in MainWindow.FilePreviewer_PreviewSizeChanged. Please keep the 4K/175% centering examples attached to #50445 validation rather than implementing two competing fixes. #50244 is also relevant background for scaled-display image sizing.
